extension.summary: 言語設定マネージャー
extension.description: Sets the audio and subtitle track according to your language preferences
Ställer in ljud- och undertextspår enligt dina språkinställningar
Imposta le tracce audio e dei sottotitoli in base alle preferenze linguistiche.
言語設定に従って音声トラックと字幕トラックを設定します。
extension.disclaimer: For bugs, requests or general questions visit the Language Preference Manager thread on the Kodi forum.
För buggar, önskemål eller allmänna frågor, besök tråden Language Preference Manager på Kodi-forumet.
Per bug, richieste o domande generali, visita il thread di Language Preference Manager sul forum Kodi.
バグ報告、要望、一般的な質問については、KodiフォーラムのLanguage Preference Managerスレッドをご覧ください。
extension.news:
--- Version 2.0
- feat: Add regex-based subtitle stream selector with fallback support - Added new toggle "Use regex pattern to filter subtitles" in General settings - Added editable regex pattern field (conditionally visible when toggle is enabled) - New evalRegexSubPrefs() method scans all subtitle streams and selects first match - Runs early in evalPrefs() before normal subtitle preferences - Falls back to Conditional Subtitle Preferences if no regex match found - Sets use_filename_subs flag to prevent subsequent prefs from overriding matched track - Added error handling for invalid regex patterns - Updated strings.po with two new label entries (#30146, #30147) - Added support for 8 conditional subtitle preference sets (up from 3) - Added support for 6 audio preference sets (up from 3) - mistakenly included complete wording subtitles like full subtitles. added negative look back for search ‘sub’ before ‘title’ - dubtitles & dub titles still pass through just not subtitles. - changed to full line search not string only search - Implement a two-stage subtitle regex filtering mechanism to improve accuracy when selecting special subtitle tracks (forced, signs, songs) while avoiding false positives on regular subtitle files. - User selects "Original" in settings → spinner value 52 → languageTranslate("52", 4, 3) returns "org" → stored in AudioPrefs/SubtitlePrefs/CondSubtitlePrefs tuples as the code "org". - During playback evaluation (evalAudioPrefs/evalSubPrefs/evalCondSubPrefs): when code == "org", the stream_matches_language helper checks stream.get('isoriginal', False) for audio tracks, or "original" in sub_name for subtitle tracks. When code == "unk", it checks for empty or "unk" language strings. - When storing manual overrides (from_player): if the selected audio track has isoriginal=True, the preference stores "org" as the language. If a subtitle has "original" in its name, it stores "org". - When restoring overrides (get_audio_track_index/get_subtitle_track_index): the same special-case matching applies — isoriginal for audio, name-based for subtitles. - strings.po provides the UI labels (30500 → "Original", 30400 → "Unknown") that the settings spinner displays. - Changed "turn on subtitles if subtitle preference if found" and it's logic to "Turn on subtitles if a subtitle matches in any setting globally" - Added Japanese, French, German and Italian language options for UI, English & Swedish were already there. - Added "Unknown, Undefined, None, Original" language & subtitle codes and updated logic for finding and filtering them within all settings.
